reconstruction.text: Titles, subtitles, contents, descriptions, partnership cards, contact information, headers and footers are editable text boxes.
reconstruction.tables: The product specification matrix on slide 8 is a native editable PowerPoint table.
reconstruction.shapes: Lines, bullets, badges and partnership cards are native PowerPoint shapes.
reconstruction.images: Photos, portraits, robots, diagrams and logo walls are preserved as independently movable region images.

limitations: The source PDF contains only one raster image per page and has no recoverable original object structure.
Complex process diagrams, portraits and brand logos remain image regions to preserve visual fidelity.
The source itself mixes company identities and page numbering; the reconstruction preserves the visible content.
